text:
marta: Postmortem follow-up: consolidating the rollout safety work into clear owners + deliverables. Short thread.
sam: I can own auto-rollback (prototype + simulation mode). Will add API and a safety simulation so we can tune thresholds without impacting traffic.
li: I'll own per-flag blast-radius caps + migration plan. Proposal: max_users, max_hosts, max_percentage per flag.
ryan: Observability owner here. I'll add dashboard tiles and alert rules. Suggest signals: 5xx > 0.5% over 3m, p95 > 2x baseline over 5m, and cross-tenant error surge detection.
tess: I'll implement a lightweight synthetic smoke-run that runs against the canary at 5% before any further ramp. If smoke fails, hold and require manual continue or rollback.
security-team: Kill-switch must be Vault-backed with RBAC and audit logs. Recommend two-person approval for global emergency off.
marta: Suggested short deadlines: sam -> 2026-04-01, li -> 2026-03-30, ryan -> 2026-04-03, tess -> 2026-04-02, security-team -> 2026-03-31. Agree?
sam: ack. API sketch (simulation enabled):
POST /rollouts/:id/auto_rollback
{
  "enabled": true,
  "simulation": true,
  "conditions": ["500_rate>0.5%"],
  "grace_period_s": 180
}
li: blast-radius example (per-flag metadata):
{
  "max_users": 1000,
  "max_hosts": 10,
  "max_percentage": 5
}
ryan: I'll surface rollback suggestions as non-blocking annotations in the rollout UI during simulation, and as automated actions once simulation thresholds are validated.
tess: I'll add test matrix for smoke-run: login, core-write, core-read, background-worker flow. Fail any -> hold at 5%.
marta: I'll open the umbrella tasks and link to the postmortem. Quick sync Friday 10:00 to hand off. React :thumbsup: if you accept ownership.
ryan: :thumbsup:
li: :thumbsup:
tess: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
security-team: acknowledged
deploy-bot: infra/rollout-controller v2.1.2 deploy started
